name: After § 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text: 7a. Deplores the fact that, despite the deportations of foreign journalists and foreign Christians, as well as persistent and well-documented human rights violations, the EU has continued its close cooperation with Türkiye, particularly within the framework of the EU–Türkiye migration deal;
